title: Nice lightweight chairs!  Don't work as great.  Hard to push up or down
text:
Nice lightweight chairs! Don't work as great. Hard to push up or down. This barstool set is attractive, black and silver chrome. It is nice to be able to adjust it to the height you need. There is a foot rack that helps keep your feet in place. Also, there is a rubber ring at the bottom to prevent scratches on the floor. The seat is comfortable, soft, and cushioned well.

However, in testing the up and down level gadget, I had one issue. If you have this at the highest level and need to bring it down, and are not sitting on it........ lay your body on it to PUSH it down. Push hard!

I like that it is very lightweight....move it with one hand. That is an asset. However, if you are sitting on it, put your entire body on it. Do not set at the edge of the seat.....otherwise you will tip the chair. Please do not allow children to try to climb it, as they will tip if ..... if you know how childjren climb.

I am using this as a puzzle table. I have a table that adjusts and 360 degree turning radius. And this chair matches it perfectly. Plus, I am using the other one in my lower level for craft work.

features: Adjustable seat from Counter to Bar Height
Vegan Leather Seat and Back and High Density Foam Seating and Back Cushions
Durable Chromed Steel Frame and Footrest
description: Appreciate the modern minimalism offered by the Griffin Adjustable Barstool. A sleek addition to any kitchen or home bar, this stool is height adjustable, going from counter to bar height with ease, adding versatility. Beautiful vegan leather covers its armless seat and back, and is enhanced with intersecting stitching that creates a dynamic grid pattern. A swivel seat is made comfortable with high density foam, and is augmented with a chic chromed steel base and footrest.
